description: Search Swedish companies by name or organisationsnummer (10 or 12 digits, dashes allowed). Also accepts simple discovery such as 'restaurants in Trelleborg', 'construction companies in Malmö', 'IT companies in Lund', or 'companies in Trelleborg' (also Swedish 'restauranger i Malmö'). Industries resolve through official English/Swedish SNI descriptions and business aliases, e.g. 'computer repair'/'datorreparation' and 'dining'/'restaurangverksamhet'. Known counties such as Skåne and explicit municipality names use registered administrative geography. Unrecognized or ambiguous wording falls back to name search. Locality is the registered locality, not nearby workplaces. Signal-filtered discovery is refused in free search; use paid find_distress_signals for a known company. Returns up to 10 results, each with an id to pass to fetch and a citable URL. Free (Basic identity only).

query.description: Company name, organisationsnummer such as 556012-5790, or simple discovery such as restaurants in Trelleborg
